checked: Completed and diagnostic-review-required states reject mutating resume without changing any retained bytes.
An interrupted prefix resumes only uncommitted sources; committed diagnostic failures are retained and never retried.
An orphan is adopted only after exact-byte-equal deterministic replay; a semantically identical but byte-different orphan is preserved and rejected.
Literal selection bytes, descriptor bytes, dependency membership, source digests, source prefix, layout, missing evidence and status corruption reject before mutation or replay.
A legitimate resumable run is excluded by an already held nonblocking execution lock.
Full replay requires the fixed repository selection path; recorded Git commit bytes are checked against explicit dependency hashes.

Three estimator dispositions, original invalid points, complete four-step and three-comparison Hessian ladders, exact extended ladder, 3x3 derivative arrays, five profile starts, full grid, closure limits and boundary evidence are structurally retained.
Nested candidate diagnostics, missing values, statuses, booleans and integer source identifiers retain their exact discrete identities; only numerical replay fields use the fixed tolerance.
Injected root drift before an evidence write and during a root write is detected; observed bytes are preserved instead of overwritten by cached metadata.
A bound incident blocks automatic resume even if another actor restores superficially valid root bytes.
A new output nested in a different saved experiment archive is rejected without changing that archive.
Readback explicitly does not claim independent recalculation of every saved diagnostic quantity, and no replacement headline fits or intervals are claimed.

independent_test_execution.inputs: literal eight-observation arrays; mocked archive discovery and selected-source replay; no scientific random observations generated

initial_independent_check_observed.scope: first 28-case draft suite before schema and root-guard repairs; this historical check is not current certification

limitations: These are synthetic lifecycle and structural checks, not E1/E2 selected-source replay or full Week 7 experimental validation.
Mathematical formulas require the separately recorded independent mathematical review.
Advisory locks constrain cooperating writers; before/after byte checks do not provide atomic exclusion against noncooperating external writes.
Injected drift detection does not identify or repair the cause of the historical unattributed runtime incidents.
Lost pre-restart validation files and the old 971-test observation are not replaced or certified by this review.
